profile.name: Hearth Home Appliances
profile.summary: US maker of kitchen and laundry appliances (~2,000 employees, factories in Tennessee and Ohio). Sells refrigerators, dishwashers, washing machines and microwaves through big-box stores and its own website. Imports some parts from Mexico and Asia. No food, no medicine, no vehicles.
businessLines: Retail and online sales with product warranties
applies: DOE energy and water efficiency standards for home appliances
Consumer product safety rules and recalls (CPSC)
EPA rules on refrigerants and chemicals in products
Tariffs and trade rules on imported appliance parts
Factory workplace safety (OSHA) and labor rules
doesNotApply: Food, drugs, medical devices, aviation, banking
Energy rules for power plants, pipelines or utilities

product-standards.description: Energy efficiency, product safety, recalls, refrigerants

items.title: Implementing the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026

datesShown.quote: The rate of duty on goods from the largest 5 importers of crude oil and natural gas that originated in the Russian Federation shall be increased by 100 percent ad valorem if the country knowingly makes new purchases of crude oil or natural gas that originated in the Russian Federation on or after October 18, 2026, subject to the exceptions set forth in section 114 of the Graham Act and the waivers issued in section 4 of this order.
datesShown.verifyNote: quote found verbatim in primary source

deadlines.quote: The rate of duty on goods from the largest 5 importers of crude oil and natural gas that originated in the Russian Federation shall be increased by 100 percent ad valorem if the country knowingly makes new purchases of crude oil or natural gas that originated in the Russian Federation on or after October 18, 2026, subject to the exceptions set forth in section 114 of the Graham Act and the waivers issued in section 4 of this order.
deadlines.verifyNote: quote found verbatim in primary source

items.reason: Executive order imposing additional duties (up to 500%) on Russian goods and on countries facilitating Russian oil evasion; could raise costs of Hearth's imported parts and steel inputs from affected sources.
items.action: Ask Trade Compliance to check whether any imported parts or steel come from Russia or countries helping Russia evade oil sanctions, since new tariffs could raise our costs.
